{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate Fig.2: Cross-Attack (DD OOD) Bar Chart with 3-seed mean +/- std."""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import os
import shutil

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 9,
    'axes.titlesize': 11,
    'axes.labelsize': 10,
    'xtick.labelsize': 9,
    'ytick.labelsize': 9,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.08,
})

categories = ['K=1', 'K=2', 'K=3', 'K=5', 'Full']

means = {
    'Vanilla':  [0.628, 0.479, 0.389, 0.351, 0.312],
    'MLM-only': [0.973, 0.993, 0.997, 0.997, 0.914],
    '9-class':  [0.990, 0.981, 0.972, 0.997, 0.997],
}

stds = {
    'Vanilla':  [0.038, 0.038, 0.027, 0.030, 0.026],
    'MLM-only': [0.019, 0.009, 0.005, 0.005, 0.115],
    '9-class':  [0.013, 0.013, 0.026, 0.005, 0.005],
}

colors = ['#4C72B0', '#DD8452', '#55A868']
variants = list(means.keys())

x = np.arange(len(categories))
width = 0.22
offsets = [-width, 0, width]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5.5, 3.5))

for i, variant in enumerate(variants):
    bars = ax.bar(
        x + offsets[i], means[variant], width,
        yerr=stds[variant],
        label=variant,
        color=colors[i],
        edgecolor='white',
        linewidth=0.5,
        capsize=3,
        error_kw={'linewidth': 1, 'capthick': 1},
    )

ax.set_xlabel('Prefix Length')
ax.set_ylabel('F1 Score')
ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(categories)
ax.set_ylim(0, 1.08)
ax.legend(frameon=True, framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='#cccccc', fontsize=8)

ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['left'].set_linewidth(0.5)
ax.spines['bottom'].set_linewidth(0.5)
ax.tick_params(width=0.5)

ax.yaxis.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.3, linewidth=0.5)
ax.set_axisbelow(True)

primary = 'figures/paper/fig2_cross_attack_bar.pdf'
fig.savefig(primary, format='pdf')
print(f'Saved: {primary}')

sync = 'docs/paper/figures/paper/fig2_cross_attack_bar.pdf'
shutil.copy2(primary, sync)
print(f'Synced: {sync}')

plt.close(fig)
